params.label: Station spacing (m)
params.reason: The distance between two stations on a chain a person can carry. Nothing is drawn between two stations unless both are clear.

params.label: Pen passes per 100 mm of water
params.reason: Absence is drawn heavier than presence. More water missing is more ink, counted in whole passes of the pen.

params.label: First year
params.reason: The gauge has been read since 1837. I begin where the daily register begins.

params.label: Ledger
options: what the city did not keep
params.reason: Before the last sheet that shows the tank, a loss is rain that did not fall. After it, a loss is rain that fell and was not kept.

params.label: Chain stopped by buildings
params.reason: I can't lay a chain through a wall. The city appears only as the place where measuring had to stop.

params.label: Stones every (m)
params.reason: My father kept boundary stones. A boundary is not a line, so I draw none.

params.label: Hand (mm)
params.reason: A person held the chain. The shake is mine; the length is not.

params.label: Pen (mm)
params.reason: The pen that was in the box.

params.label: Tank
params.reason: The lot decides which sheet I pull from the register. It never decides what I find there.

params.label: Turn of the chain (degrees)
params.reason: North is the convention of those who own the sheet. I turn the paper to the chain.
